about_short_description.short_description: The Essential provides various food, lifestyle, beauty, travel, and apparel products in their online shop.

product.name: Fitness Equipment
product.description: A range of fitness products including adjustable dumbbells, weight benches, yoga mats, and meditation cushions for physical exercise and wellness.

product.name: Snacks and Baked Goods
product.description: A selection of snacks and baked goods including breads, babkas, cheesecakes, and fruit-based treats.

product.name: Beverages and Supplements
product.description: A collection of beverages including coffee, tea, hydration powders, and dietary supplements for health and wellness.

product.name: Aluminum Luggage
product.description: A line of aluminum luggage in different sizes designed for travel and durability.

product.name: Apparel for Women and Men
product.description: Clothing and accessories including training shorts, long sleeve shirts, underwear, socks, swimwear, and footwear.

product.name: Body Care Products
product.description: Personal care items such as body lotions, soaps, cleansers, and after-sun lotions for skin care.
